verdict.rationale: Goodwin's public content (Founders Workbench) is explicitly built around Delaware corporations/LLCs and US-style SAFEs, with only a passing mention of 'UK incentives' in the executive compensation practice blurb. There is no evidence of published guidance on UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, or French BSPCE despite the firm having international offices. missing for 10: jurisdiction-specific publications or guides on UK EMI, German VSOP, Indian FDI/ESOP, French BSPCE, or any non-US startup instrument content.
